response.overview: Zikri and Dhia have been close friends since their school days. Their closeness upsets Zikri's family because Dhia comes from a poor background. Zikri's family moves to Kuala Lumpur with the intention of separating them. Zikri later marries Emilia. Their life is happy but after Emilia's miscarriage, she can no longer conceive. Because of this, Emilia wants Zikri to marry her best friend, Dhia to have their child through surrogacy. Dhia agrees because she has always loved Zikri. Although Zikri is her legal husband, their relationship remains only as good friends. However, Emilia cannot control her feelings of jealousy and acts beyond the bounds of reason.
response.title: Cemburu Seorang Perempuan
